text:
alice.w: Alright team — planning to swap catalog entry catalyst-v2 -> catalyst-v2a in eu-west during tonight's 23:00-00:30 UTC change window. Deploy-bot, please start the canary at 23:05 with 2% traffic to canary pool and enable telemetry hooks. I'm listing fallback order below.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Scheduled canary job created. /deploy canary catalyst-v2a --region eu-west --percent 2 --start 2026-03-20T23:05:00Z. I'll post status updates.

bob.k: What's the fallback ordering? we should preserve low-latency variant first.

carla.m: Proposed fallback ladder: 1) catalyst-v2-stable (fp16) 2) catalyst-v2-quant (int8) 3) catalyst-v1-legacy. Reason: quality then cost. Also recommend 3-min SLA guardband for latency jumps.

dave.o: Rollback triggers: p99 latency > 600ms sustained 5m OR error rate > 0.8% 5m -> auto rollback. OK?

erin.s: Add quality regression gate: embedding similarity delta > 0.06 on smoke prompts -> pause and alert. I'll hand over the eval set.

frank.t: Release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-20/catalyst-v2a. It lists quantization, kernel changes, and known degradation on long contexts.

alice.w: Thanks. Also pin list: we'll pin model for 'payments' route to catalyst-v2-stable for the first 2h. Can we implement route-level pinning?

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary started at 2026-03-20T23:05:00Z. 2% traffic to 4 instances (canary pool). Telemetry hooks enabled: latency, errors, quality checks. I'll echo logs.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: 23:12 UTC - Canary health OK. Avg latency 210ms, p99 480ms, error rate 0.12%. Quality checks running.

bob.k: If health stays good for 15m, schedule progressive ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 2h with 15m holds. Agree?

carla.m: Agree. During 30% step, enable prefetched KV cache warmup for new variant to avoid cold-surge.

dave.o: If auto-rollback triggers, who will own rollback communication? Ops oncall + eng-releases. Also open incident page.

erin.s: @deploy-bot can you annotate events with 'quality_gate' tag so alerts route to ML alerts?

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Annotated. Also storing snapshot of canary logs to s3://redwood-ops/canaries/catalyst-v2a/4499995555-2305.zip

deploy-bot: DeployBot: 23:30 UTC - At 10% ramp. Observability: p99 495ms, error rate 0.25%, similarity delta 0.012 -> within threshold.

alice.w: :thumbsup: proceed with 30% at 23:50 if no regressions. I'm triggering pin for payments route now.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Pin applied: payments -> catalyst-v2-stable until 2026-03-21T01:05:00Z. Canary continuing.

frank.t: Heads-up: billing customer A has strict SLA, we already pinned payments route for them in account overrides — check overrides table before additional pins.

bob.k: Noted. Also add fallback priority change in config: set fallback_order = [catalyst-v2-stable, catalyst-v2-quant, catalyst-v1-legacy] in /etc/catalog/fallbacks.yaml

alice.w: Document final: I've updated the runbook with rollback thresholds and postmortem owners. Link: https://runbooks.internal/release-catalyst-v2a

deploy-bot: DeployBot: 00:05 UTC - Canary reached 30%. No automatic triggers. Next step scheduled 00:30 UTC -> 60%.

carla.m: Reminder: watch memory growth on canary instances; kernel 3.11 has a rare leak with long-context workloads.

dave.o: Copy. Eng-oncall ready to jump if p95-memory > 85%.

erin.s: Quality alert rule added to PagerDuty: 'catalyst-v2a-quality' -> severity P1.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: 00:29 UTC - Scheduled 60% ramp executed. 60% -> monitoring.

bob.k: If all clear after 30m, finalize swap completion at 01:05 UTC with metadata update and archive old variant.

alice.w: Thanks everyone. Will post completion note when done. If rollback happens, we'll revert catalog entry and unpin routes.
